description: Map of the Pacific and the Language “family tree” showing the settlement of the Pacific by the Austronesian peoples. Pauses occurred before the settlement of the Philippines and before the settlement of Western Polynesia. Rapid expansion pulses occurred through the Philippines, along the New Guinea coast, in Micronesia and in Polynesia.
